steps.text: Bob, how have you been?
I received your letter. I'm happy to hear you made it to Columbia safely.
We're all doing well enough. At the least, we're all alive.
Chainsmoke still wants to arm wrestle you, just once, and win. Chef remembers your bounty hunters owe him three gold coins.
It might be a little late by the time the Messenger reaches Columbia, but even so, I wanted to congratulate you.
I'm glad you could escape it all, Bob. Really.
I still remember your invitation. I'm very grateful you still remember us Sarkaz.
But—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Run! Mudrock!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Run, to Kazdel, to somewhere you can survive...!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No... No, don't say that, don't...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock—!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: And never... never look back!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: L... Leave me, run! Run far, until Kazdel, until you... reach... Kazdel...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Chainsmoke...! Chain...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Let... let's go. Hurry.
But it's hard to say we're doing well.
After parting with you, we headed for Leithanien.
We've gone through a lot. One mortifying thing is we're called 'Mudrock Squad' now.
You know I don't like to show myself. But the Infected in Leithanien needed help. They needed to be saved.
I couldn't leave them to their fates, Bob. Just like you'd never leave your bounty hunter brothers behind.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Why, why haven't the scouts reported back yet?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Not them too, right...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Don't panic.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The fog in this forest's thick. They wouldn't find us again so easily...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: But, but it's been eight days, already!

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: And we've lost twelve of our own! We don't even know who it is hunting us!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Don't be too hard on anyone... Against enemies like these, it's only natural to panic. It's only right.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...The one thing we can be sure is that they're casters.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: My friends can be my eyes, but that's all. No way to seize their silhouettes in this fog.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: But it's been non-stop fireballs, hailstones and hurricanes! They've been right by us all this time, they've... wait!

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: What if this days-long fog is their Arts as well? This isn't normal weather...! If they can make eyes of fire dance in the sky, they can—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We're leaning on the back foot, though. That's a fact.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We have no clue about their identity, their numbers, or how they're even tracking us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The moment we leave an opening, someone gets attacked. This is some messed-up exotic guerilla warfare.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Do Leithanian casters do this? If so, it's news to me...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: I... I don't know... I've never known casters like this...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: And if the Captain's tremendous gift for Arts... if the Captain can't do anything, what can we do...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...What do we do?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If we keep pressing forward like we planned, I don't know even how many attacks we'll take before we're out of this forest—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But if we wanted to fight back, we'd be fighting unknown foes in horrible visibility and falling temperatures.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Take two of us to secure our route ahead. Keep within 500m of us. Report back every minute.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll watch the rear personally.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: No guarantees they're to our 'rear'.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: My friends will guard the main group.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Fine. But don't go heavy with your Arts.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We can't risk you of all people falling.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I understand that... Thank you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Swear to me one thing, Chef.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So long as you're in contact with the main group, keep leading them forward.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Ignore whatever happens behind you... never look back.
Bob. What kind of place is Columbia?
I've heard that the Infected are allowed a life so long as they work. They form the low-cost workforce she needs to serve her limitless expansion, and nothing more.
Even so, I guess you're all very suited to the work? Is your farm big? Are the wheat fields swept in the autumn winds as beautiful as the movies say?
Though it's hard to admit, I've never seen real hops for myself.
I've asked a lot of people, and I've even sought out books on botany... so I have an idea of what hops flowers look like.
If I find my own calm corner of the world to live in, I'll write to you from there. If I do, could you send me a small sample in return?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: What's happening!? What's going on!?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: My skin... the crystals are moving, they're moving inside me—I—my—gaaahh—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They're... they're trying to use the Infected as Arts Units...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They couldn't... they can't! Where the hell are the casters? These Arts... how could someone manage to do this!?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Where's Mudrock!? Is Mudrock still there!?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Gasp... keep... your distance!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They're nearby, I can feel it, it's like witchcraft... No modern Arts are like this...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They're using... the Originium—ghhak—inside the Infected...!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Snap out of it!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Boulders, find my enemy—!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't... don't waste the energy, Mudrock!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're still... far from returning to the fertile land... You need to live on!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No—!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Your hand! The crystals, piercing your skin... I need to...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hah-hah... the imagination they must have to 'use' Infected like this... Those hatted casters... they're terrifying.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Mudrock.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: —I'm here.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Take the rest of us, and live... to return to Kazdel. Yes—to return to our home—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hah, our home...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Didn't we know deep down... we had nothing, wherever we went. As long we can live on, who cares where we go?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Grhk—Like hell I'd let my life be their weapon! Tell all the others—I died fighting!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Wait...!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You... Why...? No warrior's end should be by his own hands...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: —Come out here!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Come out, right now—!
Rock echoes the wrathful Sarkaz. The colossus stands tall. Stands as if a monument to the deceased.
The frigid wind howls through the forest.
Figures seem to stand in the far distance. Or perhaps they are only broken, shuddering tree trunks.
The colossus flies forth for them.
Bob. Sorry for rambling on like this.
We've departed Leithanien. To return to Kazdel.
The journey is long. It may be dangerous. In the short time we had, I could not find a Messenger to take this letter for me.
If we can make it to Kazdel safely, and the Infected who've come with us can settle down—
—Afterwards, I might pay a visit to Columbia to see you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock, you're okay! The others...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Goddamn it...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We left a single forest. It cost half of us to do so...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Mudrock.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Can we fight back?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Our group... has so many civilians, still. We can't...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ...Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Ah... Is something wrong?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Our pursuers... There might... be something we know about them.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Them, their Originium Arts... taking Infected lives as toys...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: This sort of thing... should have long since faded into the past... but a few nobles research it, still...

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: They must be attendants of the towers, or Arts researchers... damn them, damn them...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...As long as they're not 'Knights,' worse has not yet come to worst.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Don't worry... At the very least, for now... we've escaped them.
The way back to Kazdel... is a long, long one.
So long that I've forgotten how my homeland looks.
Kazdel is a desolate barren. Still, some wanderers have taken to the old ruins of bygone wars. Founded towns you could call prosperous.
Resplendent cities the Sarkaz had never been allowed to have. But I'm only asking for somewhere quiet. A place to catch my breath for a while, in the middle of this age-old conflict.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Past this mountain, we'll be in Kazdel...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: From the top, we should see a great bridge, and past the river... a hundred kilometers north, a village where outsiders have settled.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ...Is that where we're headed?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I once... lived there.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock, we've finished securing our route ahead. No sign of any pursuers.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Good...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Let's move. We'll pitch our camp on the other side of the river before sundown.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Mudrock!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Twenty-odd of our mercenaries got attacked by that lot! We never even so much as saw their faces!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...We can't fight them. Too dangerous... Would you send your people to die like that?

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: We-We're sorry... we just...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: No... I wasn't saying to... *Sigh*.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Move. Don't look back.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll keep the rear.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Ah... sorry. I fell asleep...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You're exhausted.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You haven't given your Arts any rest since the attack.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I'll be fine.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: *Sigh* No-one can change your mind, I've learned that much.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...You know, I'm beginning to miss the good old days, when we were fighting Leithanians we could actually see.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The Gendarmerie, the armed guards, the militiamen. Hell, even the caster regiments...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We did everything we could to avoid conflict with them... After all, they didn't want to risk going down with us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But ever since last month, things changed.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Mudrock, promise not to laugh at me, but I'm a little scared.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Casters cloaking their true colors. Fearful Arts. Completely unable to protect ourselves. Where's the shame in being afraid?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yeah. You're not wrong, for sure.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...If, and this is only hypothetical, if they were still behind us even now... or suppose they're on the other side of the bridge. What then?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Would we have to fight? Or—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Casters, with few exceptions, are frail. We are many and strong. They know that all too well... their Arts are strange, and powerful...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But the strongest caster is still a human. Don't be afraid.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They kept pace with our march in the forest. For a whole month, we never found any of their camps, never found any of their supply convoys, never even found a single trace of their movements...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Only lone teams, one after another, failing to returning contact.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Turning Infected into Arts Units... it's possible, but the concept itself... no, even the raw difficulty would be far too...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Ah, I see... they're experimenting.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We're the perfect test subjects. An inexhaustible supply of them.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: From their point of view, that is... all we are.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Then who the hell are they?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Good question...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Past here, we should see the village in the basin.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The final stretch... and then we'll be...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Wait until the scouts come back... See how things are in the village.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Maybe this is where... we can start thinking about life afterwards.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Life afterwards? We can... finally call an end to our flight...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...Now we lay down our weapons and begin anew?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What kind of life to live, I wonder...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock? Where are you going?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hm... To take a look from the hilltop.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Alright. Stay in contact. We can set off at any time.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Mm.
Before I left for Leithanien, I had been putting off the question.
Was returning to Kazdel truly right? Can a new life happen just like that?
What I witnessed in Leithanien taught me many things.
There are times when fate, destiny and such become a simple excuse. A byword for all of life's unchanging paths.
I only want to live on... I want us all to live on.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Kazdel's villages... are more prosperous than before.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Cooking smoke. Wagons. Markets.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: How long has it been since I last saw—hm?
Yet some things—
—you cannot run from.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Are these...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...bones?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: There's fog again... I don't know if it's just the fog of morning in the mountains, or...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But either way, everyone's shaken. We need you to calm us all down.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Mm—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yes. I can barely see the village from here anymore... fog has come.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Wait until the scouts return. Then come to me here.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We're all here.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Do me a favor.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: What are...? Are these someone's bones? Sarkaz remains?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They were small... Probably a child.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Here. It's a broken knife. Rusted. This child might've died in battle.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Mm... help me bury them, at least.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: You could use your Arts to...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I want... to do it with my own hands.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So lend yours too.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Ah. Okay...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Everybody. In front of us is a new life.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We've made it back.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: A lot of our people sacrificed themselves for this.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Did we lose them?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: How's the village?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: If I had to say, it's bustling with life.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: There's a good few Caprinae, not to mention a decent amount of Sami people.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They've got a marketplace. Some plots of land up for sale in there. It's an old Sarkaz who used to be a mercenary, managing those. Should be able to 'get along.'

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I see... Wonderful.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We're very close to the village now. From here to there, we should have no trouble...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So go and find your new lives.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: ...Er, Mudrock? What about all of you?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...We need to stay here. See this through to the end.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yeah... about time we did some mercenary work.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: Wait...! You mean...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't look back.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: You—You brought us all this way back to your homeland, just to get yourselves killed now...!?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...He's right. I'm just in it to help a bunch of old bastards get one over. You're still young. Now's the time to go.

steps.name: Young Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Huh? You want me to run? I'd have to twist my own damn head off for you to kick if I wanted to look back.

steps.name: Leithanian Infected
steps.text: But we can't just—

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...We won't look back. All who want to leave, can leave now.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: There's no shame in it. There's no need to blame yourself... We will protect this bridge.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Supposing this is all a false alarm, and they've long given up, we'll see you in town.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Warriors. Line up. Eyes forward.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We defend this bridge to the death.
What makes us think we can escape our cruel fate without a scratch?
Do we have the right to? Do we have the capacity to?
We can't escape it, any of us. In the end, we all have to raise our weapons and confront the present we built with our past.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...How many have stayed?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Why don't you look back for yourself and see?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I... I'm just a little worried...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Seriously, you... alright, someone else, then. Hey. Count how many there are for Mudrock.

steps.name: Young Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Don't mess with me, alright? Didn't I tell you I'd have to twist my head off to look back?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...You can tell just by the sound of it. Not that many even left.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Really... thank you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: The fog's getting thicker... Captain, should we still keep an eye on them?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: Those casters with the tall hats seriously made me want to throw up... they used the Infected slaves they had with them as their... their staves.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: ...It looks like the Reunion bunch are readying for their last stand. What should we do?

options: Imagine, the Twin Empresses ascending the throne. It's been decades since the Witch King passed—
—Leithanien still hosts lunatics who mire themselves in the Witch King's shadow.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: Err... Captain, this stuff you talk about always flies over my head. Couldn't you say things a little simpler?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: Hold on, Captain, where are you going?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: Whoa, that's simple alright... But saving Reunion?

options: I only see a group of Sarkaz defending the Infected to the end.
From Casters desecrating life on the whims of rotten nobles.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: But you said they were all super powerful, right?! At least wait until our team's all together before—

options: They're no knights and garner no art's favor. They're jesters who flaunt witchcraft about.
Rhodes Island does not permit the desecration of Infected lives.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: —Someone's coming.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Ready!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: —Hold on!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Wa—Wait, what did they... do?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: That was a single push... and Mudrock's Colossus just...?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...Don't engage! Fall back!

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: That's... That's a Sarkaz...! And...

options: I've heard of you, in Operator Folinic's report. The Sarkaz who makes the earth dance.
I, too, am not your enemy.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The fog... cleared...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: —You're not a Leithanian. You give off a very unusual feeling... and you're so young...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Who are you?

options: Only a Rhodes Island Operator... Only of a kind with you, a Sarkaz.
Call me Logos if you wish.

steps.text: Bob, how have you been?
This letter is sent to you from the care of my new employer. I suppose sending a second letter without waiting for a reply might confuse things?
To tell the truth, the people I mentioned in my last letter may not have the chance to meet you again.
But there's no need to mourn. They fought to protect innocent Infected. As Sarkaz mercenaries, they never thought they'd get to die so nobly.
Maybe death can't be defined in terms of how noble it was. But the people who live on have no doubt in their minds. They died with honor.
We are not currently in Kazdel. For some reason or another, the moment we were about to make it, we looked back.
Maybe it was my hesitation that let so many of my people die. Or maybe their deaths were a reminder that fate follows as close as my shadow. None of us can escape it.
And so I decided to resist. Maybe I wanted to fight against every injustice in this world. Maybe I just wanted my friends to be able to live on.
I haven't sorted it all out yet. But we must walk forward. Only then can I shoulder all my past wrongs. Only then can I let so many more people who need not die, live on.
Oh, before I forget. I've heard a few things about you here. From a girl named Grani.
I couldn't find a home for my people like you did. I couldn't hold a candle to you. That's my shame.
Live on well, Bob. Maybe one day... far in the future, I'll be able to see you and your people in Columbia.
